scope: Durable one-store/dispatch-role admission, reserved launch capacity and integrated supervisor task issuance; selected native and real CPU lifecycle checks. No new production ABI or proof format.

implementation.authoritative_binding: DAG journal binds its own dev/inode, launch-store dev/inode, and each admitted attempt's Direct or canonical Supervised-path digest. Root/role changes are rejected.
implementation.snapshots: LVDAG001 remains readable/emitted for unbound DAGs; LVDAG002 persists root and ordered active-attempt bindings. Root survives recovery rebase.
implementation.supervisors: LVOSR001 remains readable for historical recovery only; LVOSR002 binds canonical journal path and its dev/inode. Copied/replaced admitted journals are rejected.
implementation.issuance: Supervisor::prepare reserves capacity and binds admission; Supervisor::issue_task publishes the admitted task and binds its token. Generic direct issuance cannot consume supervised admission.
implementation.reservation: Successful preparation owns a registry key before permit publication, so revocation does not need a new key at full capacity. Post-binding errors poison the handle.
implementation.retry_fence: An already durably bound attempt cannot reserve again even if a crash preceded the first launch-store marker.
implementation.metadata_compatibility: Malformed binding trailers are rejected before proof callbacks. Public CPU recovery rejects a copied DAG journal and mismatched supervisor roles.
implementation.trust_boundary: Trusted local metadata and exclusive enclosing-runtime service namespace. Same-UID hostile software and out-of-band dispatch are not authenticated by these local checks.

checks: ten explicit checks, including public CPU copied-DAG rejection and recovered-supervisor binding
injected error and abrupt exit at durable admission, worker-marker and reserved-marker boundaries
full-capacity cancellation, role/store/path uniqueness, legacy/new codecs and malformed trailers
rustfmt, git diff --check and archived-source comparison

native_validation.memory_peak_note: Rounded systemd terminal report, not exact byte measurement.

stages.verified: Captured still-live worker, durable revocation, exact kernel/cgroup stop, no result.
Fresh actor reconciles exact old worker before epoch2 rebase; resources released; historical candidate eligibility not revived.
Actual full-strength paired wrapper independently verified, durably accepted and exported.
Fresh CPU replay accepts proof and rejects wrong ordering and mutation.

live_trial.scratch_note: NVMe free-space gate and internal spill ceiling, not a physical filesystem quota.
live_trial.controller_accounting_note: Controller memory/CPU is not the prover's accounting.

worker_accounting.source: proof/worker-journal.jsonl; invocation matches persisted identity and live snapshot

proof.exclusions: Timing excludes fixture loading, admission and task/launch publication. It is neither full64 nor complete post-seal finalization.
proof.performance_claim: None. This is an admission/lifecycle change, not a matched proving optimization; lower time than prior 193.623s sample is not a qualified speedup.

prior_attempts.result: Two compile errors from moving TaskOwner construction in the wrong transport fixture; corrected.
Compile error in new test assertion on boxed Error; corrected to compare error text.
Passed before pre-marker retry fence; narrow-feature warnings corrected in d.

security.fixed_parameters: Cubic Goldilocks X^3-X-1; q128; blowup16; cap6; four random codewords; PoW16; one AIR; fresh CSPRNG and strict CPU single-zero-terminal verification.
security.aggregation: Public-proof-only; no aggregator wallet witnesses, individual proofs in blocks, curve/SNARK wraps, weakened parameters or multiple roots.
security.backend: Zig frontend with approved Plonky3 backend exception.

remaining: Reconciliation of incomplete admission before supervisor-journal creation. Before the first launch-store marker, successful reservation has not occurred; a later revocation can still require record capacity. Retry is fenced, not auto-recovered or released.
Same-boot unseen/delayed dispatch liveness without unsafe stop inference.
Concurrent CPU-verifier drain/recovery; OOM/timeout and repeated lifecycle qualification.
Physical scratch enforcement and reference-aware launch/task/artifact retention.
Actual SingleWallet/Empty/Merge operation generation, arrival-driven host eligibility/reorgs, issuance and HTLC.

Profile immutable preprocessing reuse: CpuWorker creates a local ConstructionSession and clears it for every job. Cached work must remain public, identity-bound and resource-accounted, with fresh proof randomness.
GPU redundant-transfer reduction followed by at least five alternating matched comparisons; unchanged pilot not promoted.
